note: One dev round with the forced-trigger config (config_demo_b900_forced: max_seat_delta_m 0.005, perched_is_warning false), used only to reach the re-seat branch. The shipped config leaves all 21 archived readiness checks nominal and never enters it, so the branch cannot be exercised under it. What this round is for: prove that the pre-check now refuses the re-seat before any action when the re-run capability's own predicate already holds, and that the refusal is recorded as unsupported with zero actions instead of one policy action being counted as a repair. This is a code-path verification, not an acceptance result and not a new success number; the episode is expected to end as composite_transport_not_ready because on_failure=stop is unchanged.
